player_prompt.intro:
O kerekere mo Player {player_id} ena **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Vakauta nomu i vakaro ena fomu **[macro  micro]** (rua na nambari 0-8):
• *macro*  = na mini-bodi cava o vakaro kina
• *micro* = na skwea cava ena loma ni mini-bodi ya
Kerekere ni ivakaraitaki `[7 8]` ➜ vakatura nomu i vakatakilakila ena mini-bodi 7, skwea 8, ka
vakalawataki kina nomu meca me vakaro ena mini-bodi 8 ena gauna mai muri.

O `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Na iwalewale ni kena toki e dodonu me [macro micro] ena naba 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Na inisisi me ra tu kina na kena veibasai 0 kei 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Na micro_board, laini se kolona e sega ni tiko ena vanua.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: Sa tu na tamata ena rumu qo.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Me qito na dauqito ena dua tale na laini lailai.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Sa qaqa oti na boto lailai.

game_action.played: Na Player {player_id} a vakaro ena mini-bodi {macro_idx}, seli {micro_idx} (roro {row}, kolomu {col}). Na Player {opponent_id} me vakaro ena {nxt_txt} ena gauna oqo.

outcome.win: Na dauqito {player_id} e qaqa ena Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
